description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Tool' containing static utility functions for graphical computations such as calculating midpoints, mirrors, Bezier controls and points, rotations, arc dimensions, and linear regression. It serves as a set of tools for graphical or plotting operations in the Image_Graph package.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Tool
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper functions for graphical calculations used in image and graph rendering.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns the average of two points.

methods.name: mirror
methods.description: Mirrors a point around another point by a given factor.

methods.name: controlPoint
methods.description: Calculates a control point for Bezier curves, involving mirroring and averaging for smooth Bezier spline creation.

methods.name: bezier
methods.description: Calculates a point on a cubic Bezier curve at a given parameter t.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates a point around a center by a specified angle.

methods.name: close2zero
methods.description: Rounds small values close to zero to zero based on decimal precision.

methods.name: calculateArcDimensionAndCenter
methods.description: Computes the dimensions and center point of a circular arc segment based on start and end angles.

methods.name: calculateLinearRegression
methods.description: Performs linear regression on a dataset to find slope and intercept.
